### Feedback Category
- [ ] Operative Balance (9.0 ES budget, specific specialist ability)
- [ ] Economy & Vaults (Credits, Effort, PIP pricing, Vulture Tax)
- [ ] Encounter / Mission Difficulty (Target Difficulties, Modifiers)
- [ ] Dice & Momentum Engine (Success thresholds, Momentum formulas)
- [ ] Factions & Loyalty Trees
- [ ] Other

### Proposal / Observation
What did you observe during playtesting or simulation? What change do you propose?

### Rationale & Mathematical Justification
Why does this improve the game? If proposing stat or cost changes, how does it fit within the 9.0 ES character budget or economic friction model?

### Playtest Context
- Player count (Solo / 2P / 3P / 4P):
- Campaign / Mission played:
- Number of runs:
